body:
Format:
Name of player being reported: OsamaBinCompany
Rule broken: Innapropiate name 
Evidence: Just find his name in game I have none
Anything else you would like to add?: This name is meant to be related to Osama Bin Laden, he claimed to be responsible FOR THE ATTACKS OF 9/11. Some people might find this name offensive as he is making a joke about a person who claimed responsible for a attack that killed 2,996 PEOPLE. Killing people isn't a laughing matter and he shouldn't be allowed on a server with kids and people who feel sad about 9/11 and he is just making a joke about it.

replies.body:
Hey there,
Staff are aware of this username and it is appropriate. If you have screenshots or videos which shows players being uncomfortable with it, make another player report or send the screenshots or videos in-game on Avicus. If you have any screenshots of him messing about 9/11, send them in another player report.
This report has been Denied but thank you for your awareness.
Regards,
Nitro - Avicus Moderator
